evidence.reason: The withdrawal gate at line 839 decides from a substring of a human-readable skip reason. The adjacent comment states that missing or corrupt baselines must not close a proposal, but a corrupt-baseline parse error or identity-disagreement reason that embeds file-derived text containing 'not a tightening' can make skipped.every(...) true and close an open proposal. This is an implementation error in existing intended behavior; checking restored.length === judged.length avoids matching data text and selects only non-tightening skips.
